snippet.title: Shapeshifter: Animal Run Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Transform to escape a forest guardian in an exhilarating animal runner!
Download now on:
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rikzu.shapeshifter.animal.run
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/shapeshifter-animal-run/id6529549142

Embark on a thrilling journey through a mystical forest in this action-packed endless runner game! As the forest's guardian golem relentlessly pursues you, you must shapeshift between three magical animals—wolf, moose, and rabbit—to navigate through obstacles and evade capture.

Each animal possesses unique abilities essential for survival: the wolf, known for its speed, races through the forest with unmatched agility. The moose, with its immense strength, demolishes barriers and destructible obstacles blocking your path. Meanwhile, the nimble rabbit effortlessly slips through tight spaces where others cannot venture.

In this enchanted world, your goal is not only to outrun the golem but also to collect valuable coins scattered throughout the forest. Use these coins to unlock a variety of enchanting skins for each animal, each adorned with mystical markings signifying their inherent magical prowess.

Challenge yourself with daily quests that test your skills and unlock achievements as you progress further into the heart of the forest. Compete with friends and players worldwide on the global leaderboards to claim your place as the ultimate shapeshifting runner.

Features:
- Shapeshift between wolf, moose, and rabbit with unique magical abilities.
- Dodge obstacles and outrun the relentless forest golem.
- Collect coins to unlock magical skins with captivating designs.
- Complete daily quests and earn achievements for additional rewards.
- Compete on global leaderboards to showcase your running skills.

Immerse yourself in the captivating world of mystical creatures and exhilarating challenges. Are you ready to run, shapeshift, and escape the forest's guardian golem? Join the adventure now and discover how far you can go!
